fields.statement: Attempt 2 at 7e3a3780, verifier: read the fix diff (run milestone-check now resolves each in-flight plan change set's served intents in that change set's what-if view via milestoneServed, fixing QA f1 where an intent the plan adds under a milestone in its own change set was invisible in to-be).
